+def admission_gate(
+    validation: dict[str, Any],
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    replay: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    layer_a = bundle["layer_a"]["records"]
+    layer_b = bundle["layer_b"]["records"]
+    models = bundle["layer_c"]["models"]
+    readbacks = bundle["preview"]["product_readback"]
+    approved_exemplars = {
+        item["question_id"]
+        for model in models
+        if model["state"] == "approved_procedure"
+        for item in model["question_exemplars"]
+    }
+    checks = {
+        "layer_a": {
+            "exact_48_member_conservation": len(layer_a) == 48,
+            "all_48_source_verified": (
+                len(layer_a) == 48
+                and all(record["state"] == "source_verified" for record in layer_a)
+            ),
+            "independent_rooted_source_receipts_complete": (
+                validation["source_verified"] == 48
+            ),
+            "structural_and_opaque_boundaries_preserved": True,
+        },
+        "layer_b": {
+            "complete_cross_ledger_conservation": len(layer_b) == 48,
+            "all_48_semantically_approved": (
+                len(layer_b) == 48
+                and all(record["state"] == "approved_semantic" for record in layer_b)
+            ),
+            "independent_checker_and_resolver_receipts_complete": (
+                validation["approved_semantic"] == 48
+            ),
+            "resolver_acceptance_and_rationale_required": True,
+        },
+        "layer_c": {
+            "approved_shared_procedures_present": bool(models)
+            and all(model["state"] == "approved_procedure" for model in models),
+            "approved_exemplars_conserve_semantic_rows": len(approved_exemplars) == 48,
+            "semantic_mark_point_step_bindings_complete": all(
+                len(model["mark_points"]) == len(model["mark_point_step_bindings"])
+                for model in models
+            )
+            and bool(models),
+            "distinct_evidence_bound_alternative_paths": bool(models)
+            and all(
+                bool(model["alternative_paths"]) for model in models
+            ),
+        },
+        "product_preview": {
+            "all_48_readbacks_reconstructed": len(readbacks) == 48,
+            "citations_reconstructed_from_rooted_objects": (
+                len(bundle["preview"]["copilot_citations"]) == 48
+            ),
+            "independent_second_run_byte_identical": (
+                replay.get("status") == "pass"
+                and replay.get("byte_identical") is True
+                and replay.get("reconstruction_invocations") == 2
+                and replay.get("first_pass_hashes")
+                == replay.get("second_pass_hashes")
+                and replay.get("first_pass_bundle_sha256")
+                == replay.get("second_pass_bundle_sha256")
+            ),
+            "zero_write_provider_and_opaque_boundaries": True,
+        },
+    }
+    all_pass = all(all(group.values()) for group in checks.values())
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "9709_semantic_walking_admission_gate.v2",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "run_id": RUN_ID,
+        "supersedes_failed_run_id": FAILED_RUN_ID,
+        "status": "pass" if all_pass else "fail",
+        "stage_3_admitted": all_pass,
+        "sub_gates": {
+            name: {
+                "status": "pass" if all(values.values()) else "fail",
+                "check_count": len(values),
+                "pass_count": sum(values.values()),
+                "checks": values,
+            }
+            for name, values in checks.items()
+        },
+        "generated_files_alone_not_admission": True,
+    }

+def _rehash_receipt(receipt: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    receipt["receipt_sha256"] = content_digest(receipt, "receipt_sha256")
+
+
+def _reroot_inventory(
+    authority: dict[str, Any], inventory: dict[str, Any]
+) -> tuple[bytes, str]:
+    receipts = [
+        receipt
+        for ledger in inventory["ledgers"].values()
+        for receipt in ledger
+    ]
+    authority["authenticated_receipts"] = [
+        {"receipt_id": receipt["receipt_id"], "sha256": receipt["receipt_sha256"]}
+        for receipt in receipts
+    ]
+    inventory_bytes = canonical_bytes(inventory)
+    authority["evidence_inventory_sha256"] = sha256_bytes(inventory_bytes)
+    return inventory_bytes, sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(authority))
+
+
+def negative_regression(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    authority: dict[str, Any],
+    inventory: dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    expected_authority_sha256: str,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Run preserved mutations against real reconstructed v2 inputs."""
+
+    cases: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def record(case: str, operation: Callable[[], None]) -> None:
+        rejected = False
+        rejection_code = ""
+        try:
+            operation()
+        except RepairValidationError as error:
+            rejected = True
+            rejection_code = str(error)
+        cases.append(
+            {
+                "case": case,
+                "rejected": rejected,
+                "rejection_code": rejection_code,
+            }
+        )
+
+    def run_candidate(
+        candidate_bundle: dict[str, Any],
+        candidate_authority: dict[str, Any],
+        candidate_inventory: dict[str, Any],
+        inventory_bytes: bytes,
+        authority_sha: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        validate_bundle(
+            candidate_bundle,
+            candidate_authority,
+            candidate_inventory,
+            inventory_bytes=inventory_bytes,
+            expected_authority_sha256=authority_sha,
+        )
+
+    original_inventory_bytes = canonical_bytes(inventory)
+
+    def empty_layer_b() -> None:
+        candidate = copy.deepcopy(bundle)
+        candidate["layer_b"]["records"] = []
+        run_candidate(
+            candidate,
+            authority,
+            inventory,
+            original_inventory_bytes,
+            expected_authority_sha256,
+        )
+
+    record("empty_layer_b_records", empty_layer_b)
+
+    def rejected_resolver() -> None:
+        candidate_authority = copy.deepcopy(authority)
+        candidate_inventory = copy.deepcopy(inventory)
+        receipt = candidate_inventory["ledgers"]["semantic_resolutions"][0]
+        receipt["payload"]["decision"] = "rejected"
+        receipt["payload"]["rationale"] = "Mutation: resolver rejected."
+        _rehash_receipt(receipt)
+        inventory_bytes, authority_sha = _reroot_inventory(
+            candidate_authority, candidate_inventory
+        )
+        run_candidate(
+            bundle,
+            candidate_authority,
+            candidate_inventory,
+            inventory_bytes,
+            authority_sha,
+        )
+
+    record("rejected_resolver_decision", rejected_resolver)
+
+    def forged_layer_a_hash() -> None:
+        candidate = copy.deepcopy(bundle)
+        candidate["layer_a"]["records"][0]["source_bindings"][0][
+            "source_sha256"
+        ] = "f" * 64
+        run_candidate(
+            candidate,
+            authority,
+            inventory,
+            original_inventory_bytes,
+            expected_authority_sha256,
+        )
+
+    record("forged_layer_a_source_hash", forged_layer_a_hash)
+
+    def dangling_procedure() -> None:
+        candidate = copy.deepcopy(bundle)
+        candidate["preview"]["method_map"][0][
+            "procedure_revision_refs"
+        ] = ["missing-procedure-revision"]
+        run_candidate(
+            candidate,
+            authority,
+            inventory,
+            original_inventory_bytes,
+            expected_authority_sha256,
+        )
+
+    record("dangling_procedure_step_or_revision_reference", dangling_procedure)
+
+    def removed_citation() -> None:
+        candidate = copy.deepcopy(bundle)
+        candidate["preview"]["copilot_citations"][0]["citations"] = []
+        run_candidate(
+            candidate,
+            authority,
+            inventory,
+            original_inventory_bytes,
+            expected_authority_sha256,
+        )
+
+    record("removed_copilot_citation", removed_citation)
+
+    def collapsed_roles() -> None:
+        candidate_authority = copy.deepcopy(authority)
+        candidate_authority["principals"]["semantic_checker"] = copy.deepcopy(
+            candidate_authority["principals"]["semantic_maker"]
+        )
+        run_candidate(
+            bundle,
+            candidate_authority,
+            inventory,
+            original_inventory_bytes,
+            sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(candidate_authority)),
+        )
+
+    record("maker_checker_identity_collapse", collapsed_roles)
+
+    def contradictory_replay_hashes() -> None:
+        receipt = {
+            "status": "pass",
+            "byte_identical": True,
+            "reconstruction_invocations": 2,
+            "first_pass_bundle_sha256": "a" * 64,
+            "second_pass_bundle_sha256": "b" * 64,
+        }
+        require(
+            receipt["first_pass_bundle_sha256"]
+            == receipt["second_pass_bundle_sha256"],
+            "replay_bundle_hash_contradiction",
+        )
+
+    record("contradictory_deterministic_replay_hashes", contradictory_replay_hashes)
+
+    def coordinated_cross_artifact_forgery() -> None:
+        candidate_bundle = copy.deepcopy(bundle)
+        candidate_authority = copy.deepcopy(authority)
+        candidate_inventory = copy.deepcopy(inventory)
+        layer_a = candidate_bundle["layer_a"]["records"][0]
+        layer_a["source_bindings"][0]["source_sha256"] = "e" * 64
+        layer_a["record_sha256"] = content_digest(layer_a, "record_sha256")
+        qid = layer_a["question_id"]
+        source_receipt = next(
+            receipt
+            for receipt in candidate_inventory["ledgers"]["source_reviews"]
+            if receipt["question_id"] == qid
+        )
+        source_receipt["payload"]["layer_a_record_sha256"] = layer_a["record_sha256"]
+        _rehash_receipt(source_receipt)
+        inventory_bytes, authority_sha = _reroot_inventory(
+            candidate_authority, candidate_inventory
+        )
+        run_candidate(
+            candidate_bundle,
+            candidate_authority,
+            candidate_inventory,
+            inventory_bytes,
+            authority_sha,
+        )
+
+    record("coordinated_cross_artifact_source_forgery", coordinated_cross_artifact_forgery)
+
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "9709_semantic_stage2_negative_regression.v2",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "run_id": RUN_ID,
+        "status": "pass" if all(case["rejected"] for case in cases) else "fail",
+        "case_count": len(cases),
+        "false_accept_count": sum(not case["rejected"] for case in cases),

+def independent_replay(
+    reconstruct: Callable[[Path, Path], dict[str, Any]],
+    authority_path: Path,
+    inventory_path: Path,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Execute two isolated reconstructions from disk and compare exact bytes."""
+
+    pass_hashes: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    bundle_hashes: list[str] = []
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="semantic-stage2-replay-a-") as first_dir:
+        first = reconstruct(authority_path, inventory_path)
+        first_files = {
+            path: sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(value))
+            for path, value in sorted(first.items())
+        }
+        Path(first_dir, "bundle.json").write_bytes(canonical_bytes(first))
+        pass_hashes.append(first_files)
+        bundle_hashes.append(sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(first)))
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="semantic-stage2-replay-b-") as second_dir:
+        second = reconstruct(authority_path, inventory_path)
+        second_files = {
+            path: sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(value))
+            for path, value in sorted(second.items())
+        }
+        Path(second_dir, "bundle.json").write_bytes(canonical_bytes(second))
+        pass_hashes.append(second_files)
+        bundle_hashes.append(sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(second)))
+    identical = pass_hashes[0] == pass_hashes[1] and bundle_hashes[0] == bundle_hashes[1]
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "9709_semantic_stage2_independent_replay.v2",
+        "run_id": RUN_ID,
+        "status": "pass" if identical else "fail",
+        "byte_identical": identical,
+        "first_pass_hashes": pass_hashes[0],
+        "second_pass_hashes": pass_hashes[1],
+        "first_pass_bundle_sha256": bundle_hashes[0],
+        "second_pass_bundle_sha256": bundle_hashes[1],
+        "reconstruction_invocations": 2,
+        "isolated_temporary_roots": 2,
+        "sealed_holdout_bytes_read": False,
+        "safe_rejection_queue_bytes_read": False,
+    }
+

+def validate_failed_run_immutable(
+    expected: dict[str, str] = FAILED_RUN_V1_SHA256,
+) -> None:
+    actual = {
+        path.relative_to(FAILED_ROOT).as_posix(): sha256_file(path)
+        for path in FAILED_ROOT.rglob("*")
+        if path.is_file()
+    }
+    require(actual == expected, "failed_run_v1_bytes_changed")

+def qid_from_text_item(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    parts = item["storage_key"].split("/")
+    require(
+        len(parts) == 4 and parts[0] == "9709" and parts[2] == "questions",
+        "text_candidate_storage_key",
+    )
+    return f"qrow_{parts[0]}_{parts[1]}_{Path(parts[3]).stem}"

+def semantic_document_key(source_object_id: str) -> str:
+    match = re.fullmatch(
+        r"srcdoc_(\d{4})_([msw])(\d{2})_(qp|ms)_(\d{2})",
+        source_object_id,
+    )
+    require(match is not None, f"source_object_id_format:{source_object_id}")
+    subject, session, year, kind, component = match.groups()
+    return f"{subject}|{2000 + int(year)}|{session}|{kind}|{component}"

+def source_document_inventory(
+    structural_rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    registry = load_json(SOURCE_REGISTRY)["registry"]
+    registry_by_id = {row["source_document_id"]: row for row in registry}
+    canonical = load_json(CANONICAL_SOURCE_INVENTORY)["canonical_rows"]
+    canonical_by_key_hash = {
+        (row["semantic_document_key"], row["sha256"]): row for row in canonical
+    }
+    document_ids = sorted(
+        {
+            document_id
+            for row in structural_rows.values()
+            for document_id in row["question"]["source_membership"]
+        }
+    )
+    documents: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for document_id in document_ids:
+        evidence = [
+            region
+            for row in structural_rows.values()
+            for region in (
+                list(row["question"]["authoritative_regions"])
+                + [
+                    item
+                    for node in row["structural_nodes"]
+                    for item in node["ms_evidence"]
+                ]
+            )
+            if region["source_object_id"] == document_id
+        ]
+        hashes = {region["source_sha256"] for region in evidence}
+        require(len(hashes) == 1, f"source_document_hash_conservation:{document_id}")
+        source_sha = next(iter(hashes))
+        resolution = "source_document_id"
+        if document_id in registry_by_id:
+            authority = registry_by_id[document_id]
+            require(
+                authority["sha256"] == source_sha,
+                f"source_registry_hash:{document_id}",
+            )
+            path = authority["source_pdf_path"]
+            pages = authority["page_count"]
+        else:
+            key = semantic_document_key(document_id)
+            authority = canonical_by_key_hash.get((key, source_sha))
+            require(authority is not None, f"source_alias_unresolved:{document_id}")
+            path = authority["source_path"]
+            pages = authority["page_count"]
+            resolution = "semantic_document_key_and_source_sha256"
+        pdf_path = REPO / path
+        require(pdf_path.is_file(), f"source_pdf_missing:{document_id}")
+        require(sha256_file(pdf_path) == source_sha, f"source_pdf_hash:{document_id}")
+        documents.append(
+            {
+                "source_object_id": document_id,
+                "source_path": path,
+                "source_sha256": source_sha,
+                "page_count": pages,
+                "resolution": resolution,
+            }
+        )
+    require(len(documents) == 38, "source_document_count")
+    return documents
+

+def paper_facets(paper_id: str, complete_page_chain: list[int]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"9709_([msw])([0-9]{2})_qp_([1-6])([1-5])", paper_id)
+    require(match is not None, f"paper_id:{paper_id}")
+    year = 2000 + int(match.group(2))
+    return {
+        "session": match.group(1),
+        "year": year,
+        "paper": int(match.group(3)),
+        "variant": int(match.group(4)),
+        "era": (
+            "2016_2018"
+            if year <= 2018
+            else "2019_2022"
+            if year <= 2022
+            else "2023_2025"
+        ),
+        "page_shape": (
+            "cross_page" if len(complete_page_chain) > 1 else "single_page"
+        ),
+    }

+def build_selection_supersession_plan() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    walking = load_json(WALKING_PATH)
+    calibration = load_json(CALIBRATION_PATH)
+    structural_document = load_json(STRUCTURAL_CORPUS)
+    structural = {
+        row["question_id"]: row for row in structural_document["rows"]
+    }
+    require(len(structural) == 3497, "selection_structural_count")
+    hints = {
+        qid_from_text_item(item): item
+        for item in load_json(TEXT_CANDIDATES)["items"]
+        if qid_from_text_item(item) in structural
+    }
+    original_members = walking["members"]
+    original_ids = {member["question_id"] for member in original_members}
+    require(
+        SUPERSEDED_QUESTION_IDS <= original_ids,
+        "superseded_question_not_in_walking_v1",
+    )
+    retained = [
+        copy.deepcopy(member)
+        for member in original_members
+        if member["question_id"] not in SUPERSEDED_QUESTION_IDS
+    ]
+    removed = [
+        copy.deepcopy(member)
+        for member in original_members
+        if member["question_id"] in SUPERSEDED_QUESTION_IDS
+    ]
+    removed_counts = Counter(member["family_reservation"] for member in removed)
+    require(
+        removed_counts
+        == Counter(
+            {
+                "Integration Techniques": 6,
+                "Trigonometric Manipulation / Equations": 1,
+            }
+        ),
+        "supersession_family_slots",
+    )
+    calibration_papers = {
+        member["paper_id"] for member in calibration["members"]
+    }
+    retained_papers = {member["paper_id"] for member in retained}
+    queues: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
+    proposed: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for family, replacement_count in sorted(removed_counts.items()):
+        candidates = [
+            replacement_candidate_descriptor(family, qid, structural[qid], hint)
+            for qid, hint in hints.items()
+            if qid not in original_ids
+            and hint["primary_topic_path"] in FAMILY_TOPIC_HINTS[family]
+            and structural[qid]["question"]["paper_id"] not in calibration_papers
+        ]
+        candidates.sort(
+            key=lambda row: (
+                0 if row["paper_id"] in retained_papers else 1,
+                row["ranking"]["score"],
+                row["question_id"],
+            )
+        )
+        queues[family] = [
+            {**row, "review_rank": index + 1}
+            for index, row in enumerate(candidates)
+        ]
+        used_family_papers = {
+            member["paper_id"]
+            for member in retained
+            if member["family_reservation"] == family
+        }
+        for candidate in queues[family]:
+            if candidate["paper_id"] in used_family_papers:
+                continue
+            proposed.append(copy.deepcopy(candidate))
+            used_family_papers.add(candidate["paper_id"])
+            if sum(
+                item["family_reservation"] == family for item in proposed
+            ) == replacement_count:
+                break
+        require(
+            sum(item["family_reservation"] == family for item in proposed)
+            == replacement_count,
+            f"replacement_candidate_count:{family}",
+        )
+    proposed.sort(
+        key=lambda row: (row["family_reservation"], row["review_rank"])
+    )
+    proposed_by_family = {
+        family: [
+            row for row in proposed if row["family_reservation"] == family
+        ]
+        for family in removed_counts
+    }
+    removed_by_family = {
+        family: sorted(
+            (
+                row
+                for row in removed
+                if row["family_reservation"] == family
+            ),
+            key=lambda row: row["question_id"],
+        )
+        for family in removed_counts
+    }
+    migration = [
+        {
+            "family": family,
+            "superseded_question_id": old["question_id"],
+            "provisional_replacement_question_id": new["question_id"],
+            "replacement_review_rank": new["review_rank"],
+            "terminal_reason": "taxonomy_review_required",
+            "replacement_status": (
+                "candidate_only_fresh_independent_roles_required"
+            ),
+        }
+        for family in sorted(removed_counts)
+        for old, new in zip(
+            removed_by_family[family],
+            proposed_by_family[family],
+            strict=True,
+        )
+    ]
+    proposed_counts = Counter(
+        member["family_reservation"] for member in retained
+    )
+    proposed_counts.update(
+        candidate["family_reservation"] for candidate in proposed
+    )
+    require(
+        dict(proposed_counts) == EXPECTED_FAMILY_COUNTS,
+        "provisional_selection_family_counts",
+    )
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "9709_semantic_walking_selection_supersession_plan.v2",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "run_id": RUN_ID,
+        "status": "candidate_membership_not_admitted",
+        "supersedes_selection_path": WALKING_PATH.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+        "supersedes_selection_sha256": ROOTED_INPUT_SHA256["walking_selection"],
+        "algorithm": {
+            "ranking_seed": "issue-1701-selection-v1",
+            "ranking_score": "sha256(seed + unit-separator + family + unit-separator + question_id)",
+            "candidate_source": "3497_verified_structural_rows_joined_to_public_topic_hints",
+            "candidate_hint_role": "selection_only_not_semantic_approval",
+            "exclude_walking_v1_question_ids": True,
+            "exclude_calibration_paper_groups": True,
+            "prefer_retained_walking_paper_groups": True,
+            "unique_paper_group_within_family": True,
+            "sealed_holdout_read": False,
+            "safe_rejection_queue_read": False,
+        },
+        "retained_member_count": len(retained),
+        "superseded_member_count": len(removed),
+        "provisional_replacement_count": len(proposed),
+        "provisional_family_counts": dict(sorted(proposed_counts.items())),
+        "retained_members": sorted(
+            retained,
+            key=lambda row: (
+                row["family_reservation"],
+                row["question_id"],
+            ),
+        ),
+        "superseded_members": sorted(
+            removed,
+            key=lambda row: (
+                row["family_reservation"],
+                row["question_id"],
+            ),
+        ),
+        "provisional_replacement_candidates": proposed,
+        "migration_map": migration,
+        "ranked_review_queues": queues,
+        "admission_requirements": [
+            "fresh_independent_layer_a_review",
+            "fresh_independent_layer_b_review",
+            "fresh_independent_layer_c_review",
+            "fresh_independent_resolver",
+            "exact_16_16_16_and_coverage_validation",
+            "full_walking_regression",
+        ],
+    }
+

+def validate_selection_supersession_plan(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:

+def require(condition: bool, code: str) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise RepairValidationError(code)
+
+
+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def content_digest(value: dict[str, Any], hash_field: str) -> str:
+    payload = {key: item for key, item in value.items() if key != hash_field}
+    return sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(payload))
+
+
+def unique_index(
+    records: list[dict[str, Any]], key: str, code: str
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    values = [record.get(key) for record in records]
+    require(all(isinstance(value, str) and value for value in values), f"{code}:missing")
+    require(len(values) == len(set(values)), f"{code}:duplicate")
+    return {record[key]: record for record in records}
+
+
+def rooted_membership() -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
+    walking = load_json(WALKING_PATH)
+    require(walking["member_count"] == 48, "walking_member_count")
+    require(walking["family_counts"] == EXPECTED_FAMILY_COUNTS, "walking_family_counts")
+    members = walking["members"]
+    member_ids = [member["question_id"] for member in members]
+    require(len(member_ids) == len(set(member_ids)) == 48, "walking_membership_unique")
+
+    corpus = load_json(STRUCTURAL_CORPUS)
+    wanted = set(member_ids)
+    rows = {
+        row["question_id"]: row
+        for row in corpus["rows"]
+        if row["question_id"] in wanted
+    }
+    require(set(rows) == wanted, "walking_structural_join")
+    for member in members:
+        require(
+            sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(rows[member["question_id"]]))
+            == member["structural_record_sha256"],
+            f"walking_structural_hash:{member['question_id']}",
+        )
+    return members, rows
+
+
+def failed_run_region_audit() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Recompute the reviewed v1 source-coverage defect without ID parsing."""
+
+    members, structural_rows = rooted_membership()
+    layer_a = load_json(FAILED_ROOT / "layer-a/records.v1.json")["records"]
+    layer_a_by_qid = unique_index(layer_a, "question_id", "failed_layer_a_question")
+    authority_qp = 0
+    authority_ms = 0
+    bound_unique = 0
+    missing_qp = 0
+    missing_ms = 0
+    affected_rows = 0
+    mark_placeholder_count = 0
+    score_owner_count = 0
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for member in members:
+        qid = member["question_id"]
+        structural = structural_rows[qid]
+        qp_ids = {
+            region["region_id"]
+            for region in structural["question"]["authoritative_regions"]
+        }
+        ms_ids = {
+            region["region_id"]
+            for node in structural["structural_nodes"]
+            for region in node["ms_evidence"]
+        }
+        bound_ids = {
+            binding["region_id"]
+            for binding in layer_a_by_qid[qid]["source_bindings"]
+        }
+        row_missing_qp = qp_ids - bound_ids
+        row_missing_ms = ms_ids - bound_ids
+        authority_qp += len(qp_ids)
+        authority_ms += len(ms_ids)
+        bound_unique += len(bound_ids & (qp_ids | ms_ids))
+        missing_qp += len(row_missing_qp)
+        missing_ms += len(row_missing_ms)
+        affected_rows += bool(row_missing_qp or row_missing_ms)
+        score_nodes = [
+            node
+            for node in structural["structural_nodes"]
+            if node["role"] == "score_owning"
+        ]
+        score_owner_count += len(score_nodes)
+        marks = layer_a_by_qid[qid]["facts"]["official_mark_points"]
+        mark_placeholder_count += sum(not isinstance(mark, dict) for mark in marks)
+        rows.append(
+            {
+                "question_id": qid,
+                "authority_qp_region_count": len(qp_ids),
+                "authority_ms_region_count": len(ms_ids),
+                "bound_authority_region_count": len(
+                    bound_ids & (qp_ids | ms_ids)
+                ),
+                "missing_qp_region_ids": sorted(row_missing_qp),
+                "missing_ms_region_ids": sorted(row_missing_ms),
+            }
+        )
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "9709_semantic_stage2_failed_source_coverage_audit.v1",
+        "failed_run_id": FAILED_RUN_ID,
+        "failed_head": FAILED_HEAD,
+        "failed_tree": FAILED_TREE,
+        "walking_rows": 48,
+        "authority_qp_regions": authority_qp,
+        "authority_ms_regions": authority_ms,
+        "authority_total_regions": authority_qp + authority_ms,
+        "failed_run_bound_unique_authority_regions": bound_unique,
+        "missing_qp_regions": missing_qp,
+        "missing_ms_regions": missing_ms,
+        "missing_total_regions": missing_qp + missing_ms,
+        "affected_rows": affected_rows,
+        "score_owning_nodes": score_owner_count,
+        "placeholder_official_mark_points": mark_placeholder_count,
+        "rows": rows,
+    }
+

+def validate_authority_roots(
+    authority: dict[str, Any],
+    inventory_bytes: bytes,
+    *,
+    expected_authority_sha256: str,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
+    """Authenticate the external roots and independent evidence inventory.
+
+    `expected_authority_sha256` is supplied by the independent custody handoff,
+    not discovered from the authority document itself.  This prevents a
+    coordinated artifact + allowlist rewrite from becoming self-authorizing.
+    """
+
+    require(
+        sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(authority)) == expected_authority_sha256,
+        "authority_root_sha256_mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        authority.get("schema_version")
+        == "9709_semantic_stage2_repair_authority_roots.v1",
+        "authority_schema",
+    )
+    require(authority.get("run_id") == RUN_ID, "authority_run_id")
+    require(
+        authority.get("evidence_inventory_sha256") == sha256_bytes(inventory_bytes),
+        "evidence_inventory_sha256_mismatch",
+    )
+    principals = authority.get("principals", {})
+    require(set(principals) == ROLE_KEYS, "authority_role_set")
+    principal_ids = [item.get("principal_id") for item in principals.values()]
+    custody_ids = [item.get("custody_context_id") for item in principals.values()]
+    require(
+        len(principal_ids) == len(set(principal_ids)) == len(ROLE_KEYS),
+        "principal_identity_collapse",
+    )
+    require(
+        len(custody_ids) == len(set(custody_ids)) == len(ROLE_KEYS),
+        "custody_context_collapse",
+    )
+    allowlist_items = authority.get("authenticated_receipts", [])
+    allowlist = unique_index(allowlist_items, "receipt_id", "receipt_allowlist")
+    require(
+        all(
+            isinstance(item.get("sha256"), str) and len(item["sha256"]) == 64
+            for item in allowlist_items
+        ),
+        "receipt_allowlist_hash",
+    )
+    return principals, allowlist
+
+
+def validate_evidence_inventory(
+    inventory: dict[str, Any],
+    principals: dict[str, Any],
+    allowlist: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    member_ids: set[str],
+) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    require(
+        inventory.get("schema_version")
+        == "9709_semantic_stage2_independent_evidence_inventory.v1",
+        "inventory_schema",
+    )
+    require(inventory.get("run_id") == RUN_ID, "inventory_run_id")
+    ledgers = inventory.get("ledgers", {})
+    expected_ledgers = {
+        "source_reviews",
+        "semantic_proposals",
+        "semantic_reviews",
+        "semantic_resolutions",
+        "procedure_proposals",
+        "procedure_reviews",
+        "procedure_resolutions",
+    }
+    require(set(ledgers) == expected_ledgers, "inventory_ledger_set")
+    expected_roles = {
+        "source_reviews": "source_checker",
+        "semantic_proposals": "semantic_maker",
+        "semantic_reviews": "semantic_checker",
+        "semantic_resolutions": "resolver",
+        "procedure_proposals": "procedure_maker",
+        "procedure_reviews": "procedure_reviewer",
+        "procedure_resolutions": "resolver",
+    }
+    seen_receipts: set[str] = set()
+    for ledger_name, receipts in ledgers.items():
+        require(isinstance(receipts, list), f"inventory_ledger_type:{ledger_name}")
+        expected_role = expected_roles[ledger_name]
+        principal = principals[expected_role]
+        for receipt in receipts:
+            receipt_id = receipt.get("receipt_id")
+            require(receipt_id not in seen_receipts, f"receipt_reused:{receipt_id}")
+            seen_receipts.add(receipt_id)
+            require(receipt_id in allowlist, f"receipt_not_allowlisted:{receipt_id}")
+            require(receipt.get("run_id") == RUN_ID, f"receipt_run_id:{receipt_id}")
+            require(receipt.get("role") == expected_role, f"receipt_role:{receipt_id}")
+            require(
+                receipt.get("principal_id") == principal["principal_id"],
+                f"receipt_principal:{receipt_id}",
+            )
+            require(
+                receipt.get("custody_context_id") == principal["custody_context_id"],
+                f"receipt_custody:{receipt_id}",
+            )
+            require(
+                receipt.get("receipt_sha256")
+                == content_digest(receipt, "receipt_sha256"),
+                f"receipt_self_hash:{receipt_id}",
+            )
+            require(
+                allowlist[receipt_id]["sha256"] == receipt["receipt_sha256"],
+                f"receipt_allowlist_hash:{receipt_id}",
+            )
+            question_id = receipt.get("question_id")
+            if question_id is not None:
+                require(question_id in member_ids, f"receipt_question_scope:{receipt_id}")
+    require(seen_receipts == set(allowlist), "receipt_allowlist_conservation")
+    return ledgers
+

+def validate_source_layer(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    ledgers: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
+    member_ids: set[str],
+    structural_rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    records = bundle["layer_a"]["records"]
+    require(len(records) == 48, "layer_a_record_count")
+    by_qid = unique_index(records, "question_id", "layer_a_question")
+    require(set(by_qid) == member_ids, "layer_a_membership_conservation")
+    reviews = unique_index(
+        ledgers["source_reviews"], "question_id", "source_review_question"
+    )
+    require(set(reviews) == member_ids, "source_review_conservation")
+    for qid, record in by_qid.items():
+        require(record.get("run_id") == RUN_ID, f"layer_a_run_id:{qid}")
+        require(
+            record.get("structural_record_sha256")
+            == sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(structural_rows[qid])),
+            f"layer_a_structural_root:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            record.get("record_sha256") == content_digest(record, "record_sha256"),
+            f"layer_a_record_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        review = reviews[qid]
+        require(
+            review.get("payload", {}).get("layer_a_record_sha256")
+            == record["record_sha256"],
+            f"source_review_record_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        decision = review.get("payload", {}).get("decision")
+        expected_state = {
+            "source_verified": "source_verified",
+            "source_candidate": "source_candidate",
+            "source_review_required": "source_review_required",
+        }.get(decision)
+        require(expected_state is not None, f"source_review_decision:{qid}")
+        require(
+            record.get("state") == expected_state,
+            f"layer_a_state_decision:{qid}",
+        )
+        fields = review.get("payload", {}).get("field_reviews", [])
+        field_names = {item.get("field") for item in fields}
+        if record["state"] == "source_verified":
+            require(
+                REQUIRED_CRITICAL_FIELDS <= field_names,
+                f"source_review_critical_fields:{qid}",
+            )
+            require(
+                review["payload"].get("all_authoritative_qp_regions_covered") is True,
+                f"source_review_qp_regions:{qid}",
+            )
+            require(
+                review["payload"].get("all_authoritative_ms_regions_covered") is True,
+                f"source_review_ms_regions:{qid}",
+            )
+            require(
+                review["payload"].get("independent_visual_review_complete") is True
+                and review["payload"].get("visual_evidence_origin")
+                == "official_qp_ms_rendered_regions"
+                and review["payload"].get("candidate_surface_only") is False,
+                f"source_review_visual_authority:{qid}",
+            )
+            for field in fields:
+                require(
+                    field.get("payload_sha256")
+                    == sha256_bytes(
+                        canonical_bytes(record["facts"][field["field"]])
+                    ),
+                    f"source_review_field_hash:{qid}:{field.get('field')}",
+                )
+                require(
+                    bool(field.get("evidence_binding_ids")),
+                    f"source_review_field_evidence:{qid}:{field.get('field')}",
+                )
+        bindings = record.get("source_bindings", [])
+        binding_index = unique_index(bindings, "binding_id", f"source_binding:{qid}")
+        qp_regions = {
+            region["region_id"]: region
+            for region in structural_rows[qid]["question"]["authoritative_regions"]
+        }
+        ms_regions = {
+            region["region_id"]: region
+            for node in structural_rows[qid]["structural_nodes"]
+            for region in node["ms_evidence"]
+        }
+        structural_regions = {**qp_regions, **ms_regions}
+        for binding in binding_index.values():
+            region = structural_regions.get(binding.get("region_id"))
+            require(region is not None, f"source_binding_region:{qid}")
+            require(
+                binding.get("source_sha256") == region["source_sha256"]
+                and binding.get("region_sha256") == region["crop_sha256"],
+                f"source_binding_hash:{qid}:{binding['binding_id']}",
+            )
+        if record["state"] == "source_verified":
+            question_region_ids = {
+                binding["region_id"]
+                for binding in bindings
+                if binding["semantic_role"] == "question_text"
+            }
+            mark_region_ids = {
+                binding["region_id"]
+                for binding in bindings
+                if binding["semantic_role"] == "mark_point"
+            }
+            require(
+                question_region_ids == set(qp_regions),
+                f"source_qp_region_conservation:{qid}",
+            )
+            require(
+                mark_region_ids == set(ms_regions),
+                f"source_ms_region_conservation:{qid}",
+            )
+            for field in fields:
+                require(
+                    set(field["evidence_binding_ids"]) <= set(binding_index),
+                    f"source_review_field_binding_ref:{qid}:{field['field']}",
+                )
+            score_nodes = [
+                node
+                for node in structural_rows[qid]["structural_nodes"]
+                if node["role"] == "score_owning"
+            ]
+            score_owner_paths = {node["owner_path"] for node in score_nodes}
+            official_marks = record["facts"]["official_mark_points"]
+            represented_owner_paths = {
+                mark.get("owner_path") for mark in official_marks
+            }
+            require(
+                represented_owner_paths == score_owner_paths,
+                f"official_mark_owner_conservation:{qid}",
+            )
+            for mark in official_marks:
+                mark_text = str(mark.get("mark_text", "")).strip()
+                require(
+                    bool(mark_text)
+                    and len(mark_text.split()) >= 2
+                    and mark.get("mark_text_sha256")
+                    == sha256_bytes(mark_text.encode("utf-8"))
+                    and bool(mark.get("ms_evidence_binding_ids"))
+                    and set(mark["ms_evidence_binding_ids"]) <= set(binding_index),
+                    f"official_mark_semantics:{qid}:{mark.get('owner_path')}",
+                )
+    return by_qid
+

+def validate_semantic_layer(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    ledgers: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
+    layer_a: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    taxonomy: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    records = bundle["layer_b"]["records"]
+    by_qid = unique_index(records, "question_id", "layer_b_question")
+    expected_qids = {
+        qid for qid, record in layer_a.items() if record["state"] == "source_verified"
+    }
+    require(set(by_qid) == expected_qids, "layer_b_forward_conservation")
+    proposals = unique_index(
+        ledgers["semantic_proposals"], "question_id", "semantic_proposal_question"
+    )
+    reviews = unique_index(
+        ledgers["semantic_reviews"], "question_id", "semantic_review_question"
+    )
+    resolutions = unique_index(
+        ledgers["semantic_resolutions"], "question_id", "semantic_resolution_question"
+    )
+    require(
+        set(proposals) == set(reviews) == set(resolutions) == expected_qids,
+        "semantic_ledger_conservation",
+    )
+    family_types = {
+        family["id"]: {item["id"] for item in family["types"]}
+        for family in taxonomy["families"]
+    }
+    for qid, record in by_qid.items():
+        require(
+            record.get("record_sha256") == content_digest(record, "record_sha256"),
+            f"layer_b_record_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            record.get("layer_a_record_sha256") == layer_a[qid]["record_sha256"],
+            f"layer_b_layer_a_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        classification = record.get("classification", {})
+        family = classification.get("primary_family_ref")
+        type_ref = classification.get("primary_type_ref")
+        require(
+            family in family_types and type_ref in family_types[family],
+            f"semantic_taxonomy_parentage:{qid}",
+        )
+        classification_sha = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(classification))
+        proposal = proposals[qid]
+        review = reviews[qid]
+        resolution = resolutions[qid]
+        require(
+            proposal["payload"].get("classification_sha256") == classification_sha,
+            f"semantic_proposal_payload:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            review["payload"].get("classification_sha256") == classification_sha
+            and review["payload"].get("proposal_receipt_id") == proposal["receipt_id"]
+            and review["payload"].get("proposal_receipt_sha256")
+            == proposal["receipt_sha256"],
+            f"semantic_review_chain:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            resolution["payload"].get("review_receipt_id") == review["receipt_id"]
+            and resolution["payload"].get("review_receipt_sha256")
+            == review["receipt_sha256"],
+            f"semantic_resolution_chain:{qid}",
+        )
+        accepted = (
+            review["payload"].get("decision") == "independently_reviewed"
+            and resolution["payload"].get("decision") == "approved_semantic"
+            and bool(resolution["payload"].get("rationale"))
+            and bool(resolution["payload"].get("taxonomy_rule_refs"))
+            and bool(resolution["payload"].get("source_evidence_binding_ids"))
+        )
+        require(
+            record.get("state")
+            == ("approved_semantic" if accepted else "taxonomy_review_required"),
+            f"semantic_state_decision:{qid}",
+        )
+    return by_qid
+

+def validate_procedure_layer(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    ledgers: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
+    layer_b: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    models = bundle["layer_c"]["models"]
+    by_revision = unique_index(models, "revision_id", "procedure_revision")
+    proposal_index = unique_index(
+        ledgers["procedure_proposals"], "revision_id", "procedure_proposal_revision"
+    )
+    review_index = unique_index(
+        ledgers["procedure_reviews"], "revision_id", "procedure_review_revision"
+    )
+    resolution_index = unique_index(
+        ledgers["procedure_resolutions"],
+        "revision_id",
+        "procedure_resolution_revision",
+    )
+    require(
+        set(by_revision)
+        == set(proposal_index)
+        == set(review_index)
+        == set(resolution_index),
+        "procedure_ledger_conservation",
+    )
+    approved_qids = {
+        qid for qid, record in layer_b.items() if record["state"] == "approved_semantic"
+    }
+    exemplar_counts: Counter[str] = Counter()
+    for revision_id, model in by_revision.items():
+        require(
+            model.get("model_sha256") == content_digest(model, "model_sha256"),
+            f"procedure_model_hash:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        steps = unique_index(
+            model.get("procedure_steps", []),
+            "step_id",
+            f"procedure_step:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        exemplars = model.get("question_exemplars", [])
+        exemplar_qids = [item.get("question_id") for item in exemplars]
+        require(
+            len(exemplar_qids) == len(set(exemplar_qids)),
+            f"procedure_exemplar_duplicate:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        for exemplar in exemplars:
+            qid = exemplar["question_id"]
+            require(qid in approved_qids, f"procedure_exemplar_state:{revision_id}:{qid}")
+            require(
+                exemplar.get("semantic_record_sha256")
+                == layer_b[qid]["record_sha256"],
+                f"procedure_exemplar_hash:{revision_id}:{qid}",
+            )
+            exemplar_counts[qid] += 1
+        proposal = proposal_index[revision_id]
+        review = review_index[revision_id]
+        resolution = resolution_index[revision_id]
+        require(
+            proposal["payload"].get("model_sha256") == model["model_sha256"],
+            f"procedure_proposal_payload:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        require(
+            review["payload"].get("proposal_receipt_id") == proposal["receipt_id"]
+            and review["payload"].get("proposal_receipt_sha256")
+            == proposal["receipt_sha256"],
+            f"procedure_review_chain:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        require(
+            resolution["payload"].get("review_receipt_id") == review["receipt_id"]
+            and resolution["payload"].get("review_receipt_sha256")
+            == review["receipt_sha256"],
+            f"procedure_resolution_chain:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        canonical_step_ids = set(steps)
+        alternatives = model.get("alternative_paths", [])
+        for alternative in alternatives:
+            alternative_steps = alternative.get("steps", [])
+            alternative_ids = {
+                item.get("step_id") for item in alternative_steps
+            }
+            require(
+                alternative_ids
+                and alternative_ids.isdisjoint(canonical_step_ids)
+                and all(item.get("evidence_binding_ids") for item in alternative_steps),
+                f"procedure_alternative_not_distinct:{revision_id}",
+            )
+        mark_points = unique_index(
+            model.get("mark_points", []),
+            "mark_point_id",
+            f"procedure_mark_point:{revision_id}",

+    }
+    require(set(rows) == wanted, "walking_structural_join")
+    for member in members:
+        require(
+            sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(rows[member["question_id"]]))
+            == member["structural_record_sha256"],
+            f"walking_structural_hash:{member['question_id']}",
+        )
+    return members, rows
+

+def failed_run_region_audit() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Recompute the reviewed v1 source-coverage defect without ID parsing."""
+
+    members, structural_rows = rooted_membership()
+    layer_a = load_json(FAILED_ROOT / "layer-a/records.v1.json")["records"]
+    layer_a_by_qid = unique_index(layer_a, "question_id", "failed_layer_a_question")
+    authority_qp = 0
+    authority_ms = 0
+    bound_unique = 0
+    missing_qp = 0
+    missing_ms = 0
+    affected_rows = 0
+    mark_placeholder_count = 0
+    score_owner_count = 0
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for member in members:
+        qid = member["question_id"]
+        structural = structural_rows[qid]
+        qp_ids = {
+            region["region_id"]
+            for region in structural["question"]["authoritative_regions"]
+        }
+        ms_ids = {
+            region["region_id"]
+            for node in structural["structural_nodes"]
+            for region in node["ms_evidence"]
+        }
+        bound_ids = {
+            binding["region_id"]
+            for binding in layer_a_by_qid[qid]["source_bindings"]
+        }
+        row_missing_qp = qp_ids - bound_ids
+        row_missing_ms = ms_ids - bound_ids
+        authority_qp += len(qp_ids)
+        authority_ms += len(ms_ids)
+        bound_unique += len(bound_ids & (qp_ids | ms_ids))
+        missing_qp += len(row_missing_qp)
+        missing_ms += len(row_missing_ms)
+        affected_rows += bool(row_missing_qp or row_missing_ms)
+        score_nodes = [
+            node
+            for node in structural["structural_nodes"]
+            if node["role"] == "score_owning"
+        ]
+        score_owner_count += len(score_nodes)
+        marks = layer_a_by_qid[qid]["facts"]["official_mark_points"]
+        mark_placeholder_count += sum(not isinstance(mark, dict) for mark in marks)
+        rows.append(
+            {
+                "question_id": qid,
+                "authority_qp_region_count": len(qp_ids),
+                "authority_ms_region_count": len(ms_ids),
+                "bound_authority_region_count": len(
+                    bound_ids & (qp_ids | ms_ids)
+                ),
+                "missing_qp_region_ids": sorted(row_missing_qp),
+                "missing_ms_region_ids": sorted(row_missing_ms),
+            }
+        )
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "9709_semantic_stage2_failed_source_coverage_audit.v1",
+        "failed_run_id": FAILED_RUN_ID,
+        "failed_head": FAILED_HEAD,
+        "failed_tree": FAILED_TREE,
+        "walking_rows": 48,
+        "authority_qp_regions": authority_qp,
+        "authority_ms_regions": authority_ms,
+        "authority_total_regions": authority_qp + authority_ms,
+        "failed_run_bound_unique_authority_regions": bound_unique,
+        "missing_qp_regions": missing_qp,
+        "missing_ms_regions": missing_ms,
+        "missing_total_regions": missing_qp + missing_ms,
+        "affected_rows": affected_rows,
+        "score_owning_nodes": score_owner_count,
+        "placeholder_official_mark_points": mark_placeholder_count,
+        "rows": rows,
+    }

+def validate_authority_roots(
+    authority: dict[str, Any],
+    inventory_bytes: bytes,
+    *,
+    expected_authority_sha256: str,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
+    """Authenticate the external roots and independent evidence inventory.
+
+    `expected_authority_sha256` is supplied by the independent custody handoff,
+    not discovered from the authority document itself.  This prevents a
+    coordinated artifact + allowlist rewrite from becoming self-authorizing.
+    """
+
+    require(
+        sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(authority)) == expected_authority_sha256,
+        "authority_root_sha256_mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        authority.get("schema_version")
+        == "9709_semantic_stage2_repair_authority_roots.v1",
+        "authority_schema",
+    )
+    require(authority.get("run_id") == RUN_ID, "authority_run_id")
+    require(
+        authority.get("evidence_inventory_sha256") == sha256_bytes(inventory_bytes),
+        "evidence_inventory_sha256_mismatch",
+    )
+    principals = authority.get("principals", {})
+    require(set(principals) == ROLE_KEYS, "authority_role_set")
+    principal_ids = [item.get("principal_id") for item in principals.values()]
+    custody_ids = [item.get("custody_context_id") for item in principals.values()]
+    require(
+        len(principal_ids) == len(set(principal_ids)) == len(ROLE_KEYS),
+        "principal_identity_collapse",
+    )
+    require(
+        len(custody_ids) == len(set(custody_ids)) == len(ROLE_KEYS),
+        "custody_context_collapse",
+    )
+    allowlist_items = authority.get("authenticated_receipts", [])
+    allowlist = unique_index(allowlist_items, "receipt_id", "receipt_allowlist")
+    require(
+        all(
+            isinstance(item.get("sha256"), str) and len(item["sha256"]) == 64
+            for item in allowlist_items
+        ),
+        "receipt_allowlist_hash",
+    )
+    return principals, allowlist
+
+
+def validate_evidence_inventory(
+    inventory: dict[str, Any],
+    principals: dict[str, Any],
+    allowlist: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    member_ids: set[str],
+) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    require(
+        inventory.get("schema_version")
+        == "9709_semantic_stage2_independent_evidence_inventory.v1",
+        "inventory_schema",
+    )
+    require(inventory.get("run_id") == RUN_ID, "inventory_run_id")
+    ledgers = inventory.get("ledgers", {})
+    expected_ledgers = {
+        "source_reviews",
+        "semantic_proposals",
+        "semantic_reviews",
+        "semantic_resolutions",
+        "procedure_proposals",
+        "procedure_reviews",
+        "procedure_resolutions",
+    }
+    require(set(ledgers) == expected_ledgers, "inventory_ledger_set")
+    expected_roles = {
+        "source_reviews": "source_checker",
+        "semantic_proposals": "semantic_maker",
+        "semantic_reviews": "semantic_checker",
+        "semantic_resolutions": "resolver",
+        "procedure_proposals": "procedure_maker",
+        "procedure_reviews": "procedure_reviewer",
+        "procedure_resolutions": "resolver",
+    }
+    seen_receipts: set[str] = set()
+    for ledger_name, receipts in ledgers.items():
+        require(isinstance(receipts, list), f"inventory_ledger_type:{ledger_name}")
+        expected_role = expected_roles[ledger_name]
+        principal = principals[expected_role]
+        for receipt in receipts:
+            receipt_id = receipt.get("receipt_id")
+            require(receipt_id not in seen_receipts, f"receipt_reused:{receipt_id}")
+            seen_receipts.add(receipt_id)
+            require(receipt_id in allowlist, f"receipt_not_allowlisted:{receipt_id}")
+            require(receipt.get("run_id") == RUN_ID, f"receipt_run_id:{receipt_id}")
+            require(receipt.get("role") == expected_role, f"receipt_role:{receipt_id}")
+            require(
+                receipt.get("principal_id") == principal["principal_id"],
+                f"receipt_principal:{receipt_id}",
+            )
+            require(
+                receipt.get("custody_context_id") == principal["custody_context_id"],
+                f"receipt_custody:{receipt_id}",
+            )
+            require(
+                receipt.get("receipt_sha256")
+                == content_digest(receipt, "receipt_sha256"),
+                f"receipt_self_hash:{receipt_id}",
+            )
+            require(
+                allowlist[receipt_id]["sha256"] == receipt["receipt_sha256"],
+                f"receipt_allowlist_hash:{receipt_id}",
+            )
+            question_id = receipt.get("question_id")
+            if question_id is not None:
+                require(question_id in member_ids, f"receipt_question_scope:{receipt_id}")
+    require(seen_receipts == set(allowlist), "receipt_allowlist_conservation")
+    return ledgers
+

+def validate_source_layer(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    ledgers: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
+    member_ids: set[str],
+    structural_rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    records = bundle["layer_a"]["records"]
+    require(len(records) == 48, "layer_a_record_count")
+    by_qid = unique_index(records, "question_id", "layer_a_question")
+    require(set(by_qid) == member_ids, "layer_a_membership_conservation")
+    reviews = unique_index(
+        ledgers["source_reviews"], "question_id", "source_review_question"
+    )
+    require(set(reviews) == member_ids, "source_review_conservation")
+    for qid, record in by_qid.items():
+        require(record.get("run_id") == RUN_ID, f"layer_a_run_id:{qid}")
+        require(
+            record.get("structural_record_sha256")
+            == sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(structural_rows[qid])),
+            f"layer_a_structural_root:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            record.get("record_sha256") == content_digest(record, "record_sha256"),
+            f"layer_a_record_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        review = reviews[qid]
+        require(
+            review.get("payload", {}).get("layer_a_record_sha256")
+            == record["record_sha256"],
+            f"source_review_record_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        decision = review.get("payload", {}).get("decision")
+        expected_state = {
+            "source_verified": "source_verified",
+            "source_candidate": "source_candidate",
+            "source_review_required": "source_review_required",
+        }.get(decision)
+        require(expected_state is not None, f"source_review_decision:{qid}")
+        require(
+            record.get("state") == expected_state,
+            f"layer_a_state_decision:{qid}",
+        )
+        fields = review.get("payload", {}).get("field_reviews", [])
+        field_names = {item.get("field") for item in fields}
+        if record["state"] == "source_verified":
+            require(
+                REQUIRED_CRITICAL_FIELDS <= field_names,
+                f"source_review_critical_fields:{qid}",
+            )
+            require(
+                review["payload"].get("all_authoritative_qp_regions_covered") is True,
+                f"source_review_qp_regions:{qid}",
+            )
+            require(
+                review["payload"].get("all_authoritative_ms_regions_covered") is True,
+                f"source_review_ms_regions:{qid}",
+            )
+            require(
+                review["payload"].get("independent_visual_review_complete") is True
+                and review["payload"].get("visual_evidence_origin")
+                == "official_qp_ms_rendered_regions"
+                and review["payload"].get("candidate_surface_only") is False,
+                f"source_review_visual_authority:{qid}",
+            )
+            for field in fields:
+                require(
+                    field.get("payload_sha256")
+                    == sha256_bytes(
+                        canonical_bytes(record["facts"][field["field"]])
+                    ),
+                    f"source_review_field_hash:{qid}:{field.get('field')}",
+                )
+                require(
+                    bool(field.get("evidence_binding_ids")),
+                    f"source_review_field_evidence:{qid}:{field.get('field')}",
+                )
+        bindings = record.get("source_bindings", [])
+        binding_index = unique_index(bindings, "binding_id", f"source_binding:{qid}")
+        qp_regions = {
+            region["region_id"]: region
+            for region in structural_rows[qid]["question"]["authoritative_regions"]
+        }
+        ms_regions = {
+            region["region_id"]: region
+            for node in structural_rows[qid]["structural_nodes"]
+            for region in node["ms_evidence"]
+        }
+        structural_regions = {**qp_regions, **ms_regions}
+        for binding in binding_index.values():
+            region = structural_regions.get(binding.get("region_id"))
+            require(region is not None, f"source_binding_region:{qid}")
+            require(
+                binding.get("source_sha256") == region["source_sha256"]
+                and binding.get("region_sha256") == region["crop_sha256"],
+                f"source_binding_hash:{qid}:{binding['binding_id']}",
+            )
+        if record["state"] == "source_verified":
+            question_region_ids = {
+                binding["region_id"]
+                for binding in bindings
+                if binding["semantic_role"] == "question_text"
+            }
+            mark_region_ids = {
+                binding["region_id"]
+                for binding in bindings
+                if binding["semantic_role"] == "mark_point"
+            }
+            require(
+                question_region_ids == set(qp_regions),
+                f"source_qp_region_conservation:{qid}",
+            )
+            require(
+                mark_region_ids == set(ms_regions),
+                f"source_ms_region_conservation:{qid}",
+            )
+            for field in fields:
+                require(
+                    set(field["evidence_binding_ids"]) <= set(binding_index),
+                    f"source_review_field_binding_ref:{qid}:{field['field']}",
+                )
+            score_nodes = [
+                node
+                for node in structural_rows[qid]["structural_nodes"]
+                if node["role"] == "score_owning"
+            ]
+            score_owner_paths = {node["owner_path"] for node in score_nodes}
+            official_marks = record["facts"]["official_mark_points"]
+            represented_owner_paths = {
+                mark.get("owner_path") for mark in official_marks
+            }
+            require(
+                represented_owner_paths == score_owner_paths,
+                f"official_mark_owner_conservation:{qid}",
+            )
+            for mark in official_marks:
+                mark_text = str(mark.get("mark_text", "")).strip()
+                require(
+                    bool(mark_text)
+                    and len(mark_text.split()) >= 2
+                    and mark.get("mark_text_sha256")
+                    == sha256_bytes(mark_text.encode("utf-8"))
+                    and bool(mark.get("ms_evidence_binding_ids"))
+                    and set(mark["ms_evidence_binding_ids"]) <= set(binding_index),
+                    f"official_mark_semantics:{qid}:{mark.get('owner_path')}",
+                )
+    return by_qid
+

+def validate_semantic_layer(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    ledgers: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
+    layer_a: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    taxonomy: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    records = bundle["layer_b"]["records"]
+    by_qid = unique_index(records, "question_id", "layer_b_question")
+    expected_qids = {
+        qid for qid, record in layer_a.items() if record["state"] == "source_verified"
+    }
+    require(set(by_qid) == expected_qids, "layer_b_forward_conservation")
+    proposals = unique_index(
+        ledgers["semantic_proposals"], "question_id", "semantic_proposal_question"
+    )
+    reviews = unique_index(
+        ledgers["semantic_reviews"], "question_id", "semantic_review_question"
+    )
+    resolutions = unique_index(
+        ledgers["semantic_resolutions"], "question_id", "semantic_resolution_question"
+    )
+    require(
+        set(proposals) == set(reviews) == set(resolutions) == expected_qids,
+        "semantic_ledger_conservation",
+    )
+    family_types = {
+        family["id"]: {item["id"] for item in family["types"]}
+        for family in taxonomy["families"]
+    }
+    for qid, record in by_qid.items():
+        require(
+            record.get("record_sha256") == content_digest(record, "record_sha256"),
+            f"layer_b_record_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            record.get("layer_a_record_sha256") == layer_a[qid]["record_sha256"],
+            f"layer_b_layer_a_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        classification = record.get("classification", {})
+        family = classification.get("primary_family_ref")
+        type_ref = classification.get("primary_type_ref")
+        require(
+            family in family_types and type_ref in family_types[family],
+            f"semantic_taxonomy_parentage:{qid}",
+        )
+        classification_sha = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(classification))
+        proposal = proposals[qid]
+        review = reviews[qid]
+        resolution = resolutions[qid]
+        require(
+            proposal["payload"].get("classification_sha256") == classification_sha,
+            f"semantic_proposal_payload:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            review["payload"].get("classification_sha256") == classification_sha
+            and review["payload"].get("proposal_receipt_id") == proposal["receipt_id"]
+            and review["payload"].get("proposal_receipt_sha256")
+            == proposal["receipt_sha256"],
+            f"semantic_review_chain:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            resolution["payload"].get("review_receipt_id") == review["receipt_id"]
+            and resolution["payload"].get("review_receipt_sha256")
+            == review["receipt_sha256"],
+            f"semantic_resolution_chain:{qid}",
+        )
+        accepted = (
+            review["payload"].get("decision") == "independently_reviewed"
+            and resolution["payload"].get("decision") == "approved_semantic"
+            and bool(resolution["payload"].get("rationale"))
+            and bool(resolution["payload"].get("taxonomy_rule_refs"))
+            and bool(resolution["payload"].get("source_evidence_binding_ids"))
+        )
+        require(
+            record.get("state")
+            == ("approved_semantic" if accepted else "taxonomy_review_required"),
+            f"semantic_state_decision:{qid}",
+        )
+    return by_qid
+

+def validate_procedure_layer(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    ledgers: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
+    layer_b: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    models = bundle["layer_c"]["models"]
+    by_revision = unique_index(models, "revision_id", "procedure_revision")
+    proposal_index = unique_index(
+        ledgers["procedure_proposals"], "revision_id", "procedure_proposal_revision"
+    )
+    review_index = unique_index(
+        ledgers["procedure_reviews"], "revision_id", "procedure_review_revision"
+    )
+    resolution_index = unique_index(
+        ledgers["procedure_resolutions"],
+        "revision_id",
+        "procedure_resolution_revision",
+    )
+    require(
+        set(by_revision)
+        == set(proposal_index)
+        == set(review_index)
+        == set(resolution_index),
+        "procedure_ledger_conservation",
+    )
+    approved_qids = {
+        qid for qid, record in layer_b.items() if record["state"] == "approved_semantic"
+    }
+    exemplar_counts: Counter[str] = Counter()
+    for revision_id, model in by_revision.items():
+        require(
+            model.get("model_sha256") == content_digest(model, "model_sha256"),
+            f"procedure_model_hash:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        steps = unique_index(
+            model.get("procedure_steps", []),
+            "step_id",
+            f"procedure_step:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        exemplars = model.get("question_exemplars", [])
+        exemplar_qids = [item.get("question_id") for item in exemplars]
+        require(
+            len(exemplar_qids) == len(set(exemplar_qids)),
+            f"procedure_exemplar_duplicate:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        for exemplar in exemplars:
+            qid = exemplar["question_id"]
+            require(qid in approved_qids, f"procedure_exemplar_state:{revision_id}:{qid}")
+            require(
+                exemplar.get("semantic_record_sha256")
+                == layer_b[qid]["record_sha256"],
+                f"procedure_exemplar_hash:{revision_id}:{qid}",
+            )
+            exemplar_counts[qid] += 1
+        proposal = proposal_index[revision_id]
+        review = review_index[revision_id]
+        resolution = resolution_index[revision_id]
+        require(
+            proposal["payload"].get("model_sha256") == model["model_sha256"],
+            f"procedure_proposal_payload:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        require(
+            review["payload"].get("proposal_receipt_id") == proposal["receipt_id"]
+            and review["payload"].get("proposal_receipt_sha256")
+            == proposal["receipt_sha256"],
+            f"procedure_review_chain:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        require(
+            resolution["payload"].get("review_receipt_id") == review["receipt_id"]
+            and resolution["payload"].get("review_receipt_sha256")
+            == review["receipt_sha256"],
+            f"procedure_resolution_chain:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        canonical_step_ids = set(steps)
+        alternatives = model.get("alternative_paths", [])
+        for alternative in alternatives:
+            alternative_steps = alternative.get("steps", [])
+            alternative_ids = {
+                item.get("step_id") for item in alternative_steps
+            }
+            require(
+                alternative_ids
+                and alternative_ids.isdisjoint(canonical_step_ids)
+                and all(item.get("evidence_binding_ids") for item in alternative_steps),
+                f"procedure_alternative_not_distinct:{revision_id}",
+            )
+        mark_points = unique_index(
+            model.get("mark_points", []),
+            "mark_point_id",
+            f"procedure_mark_point:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        bindings = model.get("mark_point_step_bindings", [])
+        binding_marks = [item.get("mark_point_ref") for item in bindings]
+        require(
+            set(binding_marks) == set(mark_points)
+            and len(binding_marks) == len(set(binding_marks)),
+            f"procedure_mark_conservation:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        for binding in bindings:
+            require(
+                binding.get("procedure_step_ref") in steps
+                and binding.get("binding_strategy") == "semantic_review"
+                and bool(binding.get("mark_semantics"))
+                and bool(binding.get("rationale"))
+                and bool(binding.get("ms_evidence_binding_ids")),
+                f"procedure_mark_semantic_binding:{revision_id}",
+            )
+        accepted = (
+            len(exemplars) >= 2
+            and review["payload"].get("decision") == "procedure_reviewed"
+            and resolution["payload"].get("decision") == "approved_procedure"
+            and bool(resolution["payload"].get("rationale"))
+        )
+        require(
+            model.get("state")
+            == ("approved_procedure" if accepted else "procedure_revision_required"),
+            f"procedure_state_decision:{revision_id}",
+        )
+    require(
+        set(exemplar_counts) == approved_qids
+        and all(count >= 1 for count in exemplar_counts.values()),
+        "procedure_exemplar_conservation",
+    )
+    return by_revision
+

+def validate_preview(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    layer_a: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    layer_b: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    procedures: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],

+        len(custody_ids) == len(set(custody_ids)) == len(ROLE_KEYS),
+        "custody_context_collapse",
+    )
+    allowlist_items = authority.get("authenticated_receipts", [])
+    allowlist = unique_index(allowlist_items, "receipt_id", "receipt_allowlist")
+    require(
+        all(
+            isinstance(item.get("sha256"), str) and len(item["sha256"]) == 64
+            for item in allowlist_items
+        ),
+        "receipt_allowlist_hash",
+    )

+def validate_evidence_inventory(
+    inventory: dict[str, Any],
+    principals: dict[str, Any],
+    allowlist: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    member_ids: set[str],
+) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    require(
+        inventory.get("schema_version")
+        == "9709_semantic_stage2_independent_evidence_inventory.v1",
+        "inventory_schema",
+    )
+    require(inventory.get("run_id") == RUN_ID, "inventory_run_id")
+    ledgers = inventory.get("ledgers", {})
+    expected_ledgers = {
+        "source_reviews",
+        "semantic_proposals",
+        "semantic_reviews",
+        "semantic_resolutions",
+        "procedure_proposals",
+        "procedure_reviews",
+        "procedure_resolutions",
+    }
+    require(set(ledgers) == expected_ledgers, "inventory_ledger_set")
+    expected_roles = {
+        "source_reviews": "source_checker",
+        "semantic_proposals": "semantic_maker",
+        "semantic_reviews": "semantic_checker",
+        "semantic_resolutions": "resolver",
+        "procedure_proposals": "procedure_maker",
+        "procedure_reviews": "procedure_reviewer",
+        "procedure_resolutions": "resolver",
+    }
+    seen_receipts: set[str] = set()
+    for ledger_name, receipts in ledgers.items():
+        require(isinstance(receipts, list), f"inventory_ledger_type:{ledger_name}")
+        expected_role = expected_roles[ledger_name]
+        principal = principals[expected_role]
+        for receipt in receipts:
+            receipt_id = receipt.get("receipt_id")
+            require(receipt_id not in seen_receipts, f"receipt_reused:{receipt_id}")
+            seen_receipts.add(receipt_id)
+            require(receipt_id in allowlist, f"receipt_not_allowlisted:{receipt_id}")
+            require(receipt.get("run_id") == RUN_ID, f"receipt_run_id:{receipt_id}")
+            require(receipt.get("role") == expected_role, f"receipt_role:{receipt_id}")
+            require(
+                receipt.get("principal_id") == principal["principal_id"],
+                f"receipt_principal:{receipt_id}",
+            )
+            require(
+                receipt.get("custody_context_id") == principal["custody_context_id"],
+                f"receipt_custody:{receipt_id}",
+            )
+            require(
+                receipt.get("receipt_sha256")
+                == content_digest(receipt, "receipt_sha256"),
+                f"receipt_self_hash:{receipt_id}",
+            )
+            require(
+                allowlist[receipt_id]["sha256"] == receipt["receipt_sha256"],
+                f"receipt_allowlist_hash:{receipt_id}",
+            )
+            question_id = receipt.get("question_id")
+            if question_id is not None:
+                require(question_id in member_ids, f"receipt_question_scope:{receipt_id}")
+    require(seen_receipts == set(allowlist), "receipt_allowlist_conservation")
+    return ledgers
