+def validate_source_layer(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    ledgers: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
+    member_ids: set[str],
+    structural_rows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    records = bundle["layer_a"]["records"]
+    require(len(records) == 48, "layer_a_record_count")
+    by_qid = unique_index(records, "question_id", "layer_a_question")
+    require(set(by_qid) == member_ids, "layer_a_membership_conservation")
+    reviews = unique_index(
+        ledgers["source_reviews"], "question_id", "source_review_question"
+    )
+    require(set(reviews) == member_ids, "source_review_conservation")
+    for qid, record in by_qid.items():
+        require(record.get("run_id") == RUN_ID, f"layer_a_run_id:{qid}")
+        require(
+            record.get("structural_record_sha256")
+            == sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(structural_rows[qid])),
+            f"layer_a_structural_root:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            record.get("record_sha256") == content_digest(record, "record_sha256"),
+            f"layer_a_record_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        review = reviews[qid]
+        require(
+            review.get("payload", {}).get("layer_a_record_sha256")
+            == record["record_sha256"],
+            f"source_review_record_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        decision = review.get("payload", {}).get("decision")
+        expected_state = {
+            "source_verified": "source_verified",
+            "source_candidate": "source_candidate",
+            "source_review_required": "source_review_required",
+        }.get(decision)
+        require(expected_state is not None, f"source_review_decision:{qid}")
+        require(
+            record.get("state") == expected_state,
+            f"layer_a_state_decision:{qid}",
+        )
+        fields = review.get("payload", {}).get("field_reviews", [])
+        field_names = {item.get("field") for item in fields}
+        if record["state"] == "source_verified":
+            require(
+                REQUIRED_CRITICAL_FIELDS <= field_names,
+                f"source_review_critical_fields:{qid}",
+            )
+            require(
+                review["payload"].get("all_authoritative_qp_regions_covered") is True,
+                f"source_review_qp_regions:{qid}",
+            )
+            require(
+                review["payload"].get("all_authoritative_ms_regions_covered") is True,
+                f"source_review_ms_regions:{qid}",
+            )
+            require(
+                review["payload"].get("independent_visual_review_complete") is True
+                and review["payload"].get("visual_evidence_origin")
+                == "official_qp_ms_rendered_regions"
+                and review["payload"].get("candidate_surface_only") is False,
+                f"source_review_visual_authority:{qid}",
+            )
+            for field in fields:
+                require(
+                    field.get("payload_sha256")
+                    == sha256_bytes(
+                        canonical_bytes(record["facts"][field["field"]])
+                    ),
+                    f"source_review_field_hash:{qid}:{field.get('field')}",
+                )
+                require(
+                    bool(field.get("evidence_binding_ids")),
+                    f"source_review_field_evidence:{qid}:{field.get('field')}",
+                )
+        bindings = record.get("source_bindings", [])
+        binding_index = unique_index(bindings, "binding_id", f"source_binding:{qid}")
+        qp_regions = {
+            region["region_id"]: region
+            for region in structural_rows[qid]["question"]["authoritative_regions"]
+        }
+        ms_regions = {
+            region["region_id"]: region
+            for node in structural_rows[qid]["structural_nodes"]
+            for region in node["ms_evidence"]
+        }
+        structural_regions = {**qp_regions, **ms_regions}
+        for binding in binding_index.values():
+            region = structural_regions.get(binding.get("region_id"))
+            require(region is not None, f"source_binding_region:{qid}")
+            require(
+                binding.get("source_sha256") == region["source_sha256"]
+                and binding.get("region_sha256") == region["crop_sha256"],
+                f"source_binding_hash:{qid}:{binding['binding_id']}",
+            )
+        if record["state"] == "source_verified":
+            question_region_ids = {
+                binding["region_id"]
+                for binding in bindings
+                if binding["semantic_role"] == "question_text"
+            }
+            mark_region_ids = {
+                binding["region_id"]
+                for binding in bindings
+                if binding["semantic_role"] == "mark_point"
+            }
+            require(
+                question_region_ids == set(qp_regions),
+                f"source_qp_region_conservation:{qid}",
+            )
+            require(
+                mark_region_ids == set(ms_regions),
+                f"source_ms_region_conservation:{qid}",
+            )
+            for field in fields:
+                require(
+                    set(field["evidence_binding_ids"]) <= set(binding_index),
+                    f"source_review_field_binding_ref:{qid}:{field['field']}",
+                )
+            score_nodes = [
+                node
+                for node in structural_rows[qid]["structural_nodes"]
+                if node["role"] == "score_owning"
+            ]
+            score_owner_paths = {node["owner_path"] for node in score_nodes}
+            official_marks = record["facts"]["official_mark_points"]
+            represented_owner_paths = {
+                mark.get("owner_path") for mark in official_marks
+            }
+            require(
+                represented_owner_paths == score_owner_paths,
+                f"official_mark_owner_conservation:{qid}",
+            )
+            for mark in official_marks:
+                mark_text = str(mark.get("mark_text", "")).strip()
+                require(
+                    bool(mark_text)
+                    and len(mark_text.split()) >= 2
+                    and mark.get("mark_text_sha256")
+                    == sha256_bytes(mark_text.encode("utf-8"))
+                    and bool(mark.get("ms_evidence_binding_ids"))
+                    and set(mark["ms_evidence_binding_ids"]) <= set(binding_index),
+                    f"official_mark_semantics:{qid}:{mark.get('owner_path')}",
+                )
+    return by_qid
+

+def validate_semantic_layer(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    ledgers: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
+    layer_a: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    taxonomy: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    records = bundle["layer_b"]["records"]
+    by_qid = unique_index(records, "question_id", "layer_b_question")
+    expected_qids = {
+        qid for qid, record in layer_a.items() if record["state"] == "source_verified"
+    }
+    require(set(by_qid) == expected_qids, "layer_b_forward_conservation")
+    proposals = unique_index(
+        ledgers["semantic_proposals"], "question_id", "semantic_proposal_question"
+    )
+    reviews = unique_index(
+        ledgers["semantic_reviews"], "question_id", "semantic_review_question"
+    )
+    resolutions = unique_index(
+        ledgers["semantic_resolutions"], "question_id", "semantic_resolution_question"
+    )
+    require(
+        set(proposals) == set(reviews) == set(resolutions) == expected_qids,
+        "semantic_ledger_conservation",
+    )
+    family_types = {
+        family["id"]: {item["id"] for item in family["types"]}
+        for family in taxonomy["families"]
+    }
+    for qid, record in by_qid.items():
+        require(
+            record.get("record_sha256") == content_digest(record, "record_sha256"),
+            f"layer_b_record_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            record.get("layer_a_record_sha256") == layer_a[qid]["record_sha256"],
+            f"layer_b_layer_a_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        classification = record.get("classification", {})
+        family = classification.get("primary_family_ref")
+        type_ref = classification.get("primary_type_ref")
+        require(
+            family in family_types and type_ref in family_types[family],
+            f"semantic_taxonomy_parentage:{qid}",
+        )
+        classification_sha = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(classification))
+        proposal = proposals[qid]
+        review = reviews[qid]
+        resolution = resolutions[qid]
+        require(
+            proposal["payload"].get("classification_sha256") == classification_sha,
+            f"semantic_proposal_payload:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            review["payload"].get("classification_sha256") == classification_sha
+            and review["payload"].get("proposal_receipt_id") == proposal["receipt_id"]
+            and review["payload"].get("proposal_receipt_sha256")
+            == proposal["receipt_sha256"],
+            f"semantic_review_chain:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            resolution["payload"].get("review_receipt_id") == review["receipt_id"]
+            and resolution["payload"].get("review_receipt_sha256")
+            == review["receipt_sha256"],
+            f"semantic_resolution_chain:{qid}",
+        )
+        accepted = (
+            review["payload"].get("decision") == "independently_reviewed"
+            and resolution["payload"].get("decision") == "approved_semantic"
+            and bool(resolution["payload"].get("rationale"))
+            and bool(resolution["payload"].get("taxonomy_rule_refs"))
+            and bool(resolution["payload"].get("source_evidence_binding_ids"))
+        )
+        require(
+            record.get("state")
+            == ("approved_semantic" if accepted else "taxonomy_review_required"),
+            f"semantic_state_decision:{qid}",
+        )
+    return by_qid
+

+def validate_procedure_layer(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    ledgers: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
+    layer_b: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    models = bundle["layer_c"]["models"]
+    by_revision = unique_index(models, "revision_id", "procedure_revision")
+    proposal_index = unique_index(
+        ledgers["procedure_proposals"], "revision_id", "procedure_proposal_revision"
+    )
+    review_index = unique_index(
+        ledgers["procedure_reviews"], "revision_id", "procedure_review_revision"
+    )
+    resolution_index = unique_index(
+        ledgers["procedure_resolutions"],
+        "revision_id",
+        "procedure_resolution_revision",
+    )
+    require(
+        set(by_revision)
+        == set(proposal_index)
+        == set(review_index)
+        == set(resolution_index),
+        "procedure_ledger_conservation",
+    )
+    approved_qids = {
+        qid for qid, record in layer_b.items() if record["state"] == "approved_semantic"
+    }
+    exemplar_counts: Counter[str] = Counter()
+    for revision_id, model in by_revision.items():
+        require(
+            model.get("model_sha256") == content_digest(model, "model_sha256"),
+            f"procedure_model_hash:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        steps = unique_index(
+            model.get("procedure_steps", []),
+            "step_id",
+            f"procedure_step:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        exemplars = model.get("question_exemplars", [])
+        exemplar_qids = [item.get("question_id") for item in exemplars]
+        require(
+            len(exemplar_qids) == len(set(exemplar_qids)),
+            f"procedure_exemplar_duplicate:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        for exemplar in exemplars:
+            qid = exemplar["question_id"]
+            require(qid in approved_qids, f"procedure_exemplar_state:{revision_id}:{qid}")
+            require(
+                exemplar.get("semantic_record_sha256")
+                == layer_b[qid]["record_sha256"],
+                f"procedure_exemplar_hash:{revision_id}:{qid}",
+            )
+            exemplar_counts[qid] += 1
+        proposal = proposal_index[revision_id]
+        review = review_index[revision_id]
+        resolution = resolution_index[revision_id]
+        require(
+            proposal["payload"].get("model_sha256") == model["model_sha256"],
+            f"procedure_proposal_payload:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        require(
+            review["payload"].get("proposal_receipt_id") == proposal["receipt_id"]
+            and review["payload"].get("proposal_receipt_sha256")
+            == proposal["receipt_sha256"],
+            f"procedure_review_chain:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        require(
+            resolution["payload"].get("review_receipt_id") == review["receipt_id"]
+            and resolution["payload"].get("review_receipt_sha256")
+            == review["receipt_sha256"],
+            f"procedure_resolution_chain:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        canonical_step_ids = set(steps)
+        alternatives = model.get("alternative_paths", [])
+        for alternative in alternatives:
+            alternative_steps = alternative.get("steps", [])
+            alternative_ids = {
+                item.get("step_id") for item in alternative_steps
+            }
+            require(
+                alternative_ids
+                and alternative_ids.isdisjoint(canonical_step_ids)
+                and all(item.get("evidence_binding_ids") for item in alternative_steps),
+                f"procedure_alternative_not_distinct:{revision_id}",
+            )
+        mark_points = unique_index(
+            model.get("mark_points", []),
+            "mark_point_id",
+            f"procedure_mark_point:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        bindings = model.get("mark_point_step_bindings", [])
+        binding_marks = [item.get("mark_point_ref") for item in bindings]
+        require(
+            set(binding_marks) == set(mark_points)
+            and len(binding_marks) == len(set(binding_marks)),
+            f"procedure_mark_conservation:{revision_id}",
+        )
+        for binding in bindings:
+            require(
+                binding.get("procedure_step_ref") in steps
+                and binding.get("binding_strategy") == "semantic_review"
+                and bool(binding.get("mark_semantics"))
+                and bool(binding.get("rationale"))
+                and bool(binding.get("ms_evidence_binding_ids")),
+                f"procedure_mark_semantic_binding:{revision_id}",
+            )
+        accepted = (
+            len(exemplars) >= 2
+            and review["payload"].get("decision") == "procedure_reviewed"
+            and resolution["payload"].get("decision") == "approved_procedure"
+            and bool(resolution["payload"].get("rationale"))
+        )
+        require(
+            model.get("state")
+            == ("approved_procedure" if accepted else "procedure_revision_required"),
+            f"procedure_state_decision:{revision_id}",
+        )
+    require(
+        set(exemplar_counts) == approved_qids
+        and all(count >= 1 for count in exemplar_counts.values()),
+        "procedure_exemplar_conservation",
+    )
+    return by_revision
+

+def validate_preview(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    layer_a: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    layer_b: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    procedures: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> None:
+    methods = unique_index(
+        bundle["preview"]["method_map"], "question_id", "method_map_question"
+    )
+    citations = unique_index(
+        bundle["preview"]["copilot_citations"], "question_id", "citation_question"
+    )
+    readbacks = unique_index(
+        bundle["preview"]["product_readback"], "question_id", "readback_question"
+    )
+    admitted_qids = {
+        qid for qid, record in layer_b.items() if record["state"] == "approved_semantic"
+    }
+    require(
+        set(methods) == set(citations) == set(readbacks) == admitted_qids,
+        "preview_conservation",
+    )
+    for qid in admitted_qids:
+        semantic = layer_b[qid]
+        method = methods[qid]
+        citation = citations[qid]
+        revision_ids = method.get("procedure_revision_refs", [])
+        require(
+            method.get("semantic_record_sha256") == semantic["record_sha256"],
+            f"preview_semantic_hash:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            method.get("family_ref")
+            == semantic["classification"]["primary_family_ref"]
+            and method.get("type_ref")
+            == semantic["classification"]["primary_type_ref"],
+            f"preview_semantic_projection:{qid}",
+        )
+        require(
+            revision_ids
+            and all(
+                revision in procedures
+                and procedures[revision]["state"] == "approved_procedure"
+                for revision in revision_ids
+            ),
+            f"preview_procedure_refs:{qid}",
+        )
+        authoritative_bindings = {
+            item["binding_id"]: item
+            for item in layer_a[qid]["source_bindings"]
+            if item["semantic_role"] in {"question_text", "mark_point"}
+        }
+        cited = unique_index(
+            citation.get("citations", []), "binding_id", f"citation_binding:{qid}"
+        )
+        require(set(cited) == set(authoritative_bindings), f"citation_conservation:{qid}")
+        require(
+            all(cited[key] == value for key, value in authoritative_bindings.items()),
+            f"citation_rooted_payload:{qid}",
+        )
+        reconstructed = {
+            "question_id": qid,
+            "semantic_record_sha256": semantic["record_sha256"],
+            "family_ref": semantic["classification"]["primary_family_ref"],
+            "type_ref": semantic["classification"]["primary_type_ref"],
+            "procedure_revision_refs": revision_ids,
+            "citation_binding_ids": sorted(authoritative_bindings),
+        }
+        require(readbacks[qid] == reconstructed, f"readback_reconstruction:{qid}")

+def validate_zero_write(bundle: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    counters = bundle["zero_write_provider"]["counters"]
+    require(set(counters) == ZERO_WRITE_KEYS, "zero_write_counter_set")
+    require(all(value == 0 for value in counters.values()), "prohibited_write_or_provider")
+    require(
+        bundle["zero_write_provider"].get("sealed_holdout_read") is False

+def validate_bundle(
+    bundle: dict[str, Any],
+    authority: dict[str, Any],
+    inventory: dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    inventory_bytes: bytes,
+    expected_authority_sha256: str,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    require(
+        inventory_bytes == canonical_bytes(inventory),
+        "evidence_inventory_not_canonical",
+    )
+    members, structural_rows = rooted_membership()
+    member_ids = {member["question_id"] for member in members}
+    principals, allowlist = validate_authority_roots(
+        authority,
+        inventory_bytes,
+        expected_authority_sha256=expected_authority_sha256,
+    )
+    ledgers = validate_evidence_inventory(
+        inventory, principals, allowlist, member_ids
+    )
+    layer_a = validate_source_layer(
+        bundle, ledgers, member_ids, structural_rows
+    )
+    taxonomy = load_json(TAXONOMY_PATH)
+    layer_b = validate_semantic_layer(bundle, ledgers, layer_a, taxonomy)
+    procedures = validate_procedure_layer(bundle, ledgers, layer_b)
+    validate_preview(bundle, layer_a, layer_b, procedures)
+    validate_zero_write(bundle)
+    counts = Counter(
+        member["family_reservation"] for member in members
+    )
+    require(dict(counts) == EXPECTED_FAMILY_COUNTS, "family_count_reconstruction")
+    return {
+        "status": "pass",
+        "run_id": RUN_ID,
+        "walking_members": 48,
+        "family_counts": EXPECTED_FAMILY_COUNTS,
+        "source_verified": sum(
+            record["state"] == "source_verified" for record in layer_a.values()
+        ),
+        "approved_semantic": sum(
+            record["state"] == "approved_semantic" for record in layer_b.values()
+        ),
+        "approved_procedure": sum(
+            record["state"] == "approved_procedure"
+            for record in procedures.values()
+        ),
+        "preview_readbacks": len(bundle["preview"]["product_readback"]),
+        "stage_3_admitted": (
+            len(layer_a) == 48
+            and all(record["state"] == "source_verified" for record in layer_a.values())
+            and len(layer_b) == 48
+            and all(
+                record["state"] == "approved_semantic" for record in layer_b.values()
+            )
+            and len(bundle["preview"]["product_readback"]) == 48
+        ),
+    }

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reconstruct replay outputs inside the isolated roots**

The temporary directory is not passed to `reconstruct`; the callback returns an in-memory mapping that is hashed before an aggregate `bundle.json` is written afterward. Thus both passes can return identical dictionaries while the real publisher has nondeterministic serialization, missing-file, or path-layout behavior, yet the receipt still claims two isolated byte-identical filesystem reconstructions. Have each pass materialize the complete output tree in its temporary root and compare the actual files.
